T: Sacramento has the best almonds. Don't argue.
D: A headstrong senior at a Catholic school in Sacramento butts heads with her mum over her plans for college.
P: Serve the mains when Lady Bird sits down to Thanksgiving at Danny's grandmother's house.
S: the big Thanksgiving at Danny's family home
Baguette slices toasted with olive oil, spread with goat's cheese, topped with roasted pumpkin, sage and a drizzle of honey.
Lady Bird and Julie eating the unblessed wafers like chips
Rice paper sheets cut into rounds and fried for 2 seconds until they puff, sprinkled with salt and a little chilli, served with a sweet chilli dip.
Almonds roasted with olive oil, rosemary and smoked salt at 180C for 10 minutes, served warm with marinated olives.
M: Thanksgiving dinner in the big blue house
Turkey breast brined overnight, roasted at 180C with butter and thyme until juicy, with sage and onion stuffing, mashed potato and green beans.
Marion working double shifts at the hospital
Chicken, broccoli and rice baked in a creamy cheese sauce at 180C for 40 minutes, the kind of dinner that waits in the oven for whoever gets home.
W: the school fundraisers and the theatre club
Fudgy chocolate brownies baked at 170C for 25 minutes, cooled, cut into squares and wrapped in paper for the stall.
K: Lady Bird's job at the coffee shop
Espresso with steamed milk poured into a glass, with a little vanilla syrup for a sweet one.

s.note: the big Thanksgiving at Danny's family home
s.how: Roast 400g diced butternut pumpkin with olive oil until soft and golden. Slice a baguette, brush with oil and toast. Spread with goat's cheese, top with pumpkin and crisp sage leaves fried in oil, then drizzle with honey.

Toss 300g almonds with olive oil, chopped rosemary and smoked salt. Spread on a tray and roast at 180C for 10 minutes until fragrant. Serve warm in a bowl beside green olives, a taste of the valley the film keeps leaving and coming home to.

m.note: Marion working double shifts at the hospital
m.how: Brown 800g diced chicken thighs. Spread 300g rice in a dish, add the chicken and broccoli florets, then pour over 750ml hot stock mixed with 150ml cream. Cover and bake at 180C for 40 minutes, then top with cheddar and bake uncovered until golden.

w.note: the school fundraisers and the theatre club
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk in 250g sugar and 3 eggs, then fold in 100g flour and 2 tbsp cocoa. Bake in a lined tin at 170C for 25 minutes. Cool completely, cut into squares and wrap each in paper for the stall.

d.note: Lady Bird's job at the coffee shop
d.how: Brew a shot of espresso into each glass. Steam milk until silky and pour it in slowly so it holds a little foam on top. Add a spoon of vanilla syrup to anyone who wants it sweet. Serve on a Sacramento morning before school.
